name: ♥ri na Gakkou Seikatsu
source:
"What if you could be small again?"

A life do-over. No, a second chance.
This chance came to Koji in the form of a lewd goddess.
His life so far had been a waste... but what if he were
shrunk down and allowed to go through school again?
Except this time Koji knows what he wants.

"Go enjoy your boyhood all over again in a school of lolitas!!"

It's the perfect formula. Loli + rural + school life =
all kinds of perverse happenings in class and the toilets,
let's play doctor and hide and seek once more with an adult
awareness! 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE111884.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
“如果你还能变小呢？”

人生重来一次。不，还有第二次机会。
这个机会以淫荡女神的身份降临到了浩司身上。
到目前为止，他的人生一直是浪费……但如果他真的是这样呢？
缩小并允许再次上学？
只是这次Koji知道他想要什么。

“去洛丽塔学校重新享受童年吧！！”

这是完美的公式。萝莉+田园+学校生活=
课堂上、厕所里发生的各种不正当事件，
让我们和大人再玩一次医生和捉迷藏吧
意识！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE111884.html]DLsite English[/url]]
